title: fix(app-shell): four more editors stop asking /layers for an item that was never published (objectui#11799)
body:
Refs #11799 (four of the five editors land; left on the card: the metadata edit page's first load of a never-published item, the embedded item editor's save, the permission matrix's package-door save re-read, and the list-view panel's read of a view that exists nowhere yet; see Acceptance notes)
Clause-②: no

The framework answers `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers` with a 404 for an item with no layer, which is every item that was never published. PR objectui#11892 stopped Studio's pillar loads from asking it. Four more editors asked it from answers they already hold; each now holds back, and what each shows is unchanged. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`.

## What changed, per editor

**Access pillar OWD overview (`PackageOwdOverviewPanel`).** Both the load and the save read every object's layered baseline beside its draft, and use the baseline only without a draft (objectui#10765). A new helper, `readObjectBodies`, reads them:
- an object the package's published list holds (the list the load reads in the same run) is read as before, both reads together;
- any other object has never been published: its draft is read first, and its layers only if no draft comes back (a failed read, or a publish or discard since the list was read).
- The save uses the row's saved state from that load (a new internal `saved` field on the non-exported row type).

**List-view panel of an `object` leaf (`useObjectListViewDraft` in `ObjectListViewInspector`).** The buffer is the draft, else the published layer. The draft is now read first and the layer only without one, the shape PR objectui#11892 gave the Interfaces leaf and Automations flow loads. A view the panel's first edit created and nobody published no longer logs a 404 on every open of the leaf.

**Metadata edit page (`ResourceEditPage`).** A new helper, `holdsNoLayer`, recognises the answer the client gives for the 404 (no code, overlay or effective layer). Every save there is a draft save, and a draft makes no layer, so:
- the refresh after a save reuses the page's own answer when its load found no layer, and asks nothing after a create (the page then navigates to the new item, whose load reads it afresh);
- the refresh after "Discard draft" reuses that answer too.

**Permission matrix, package door (`PermissionMatrixEditor`).** The editor already reads the published set list (`client.list('permission', {})`, for the admin-scope allowlist). That request is now held in a ref and the load reads it, so there is no second request (pinned). Under the package door the layered envelope is used only without a pending draft: the draft wins for display, and the artifact tier applies at environment scope only (`artifactTierApplies`). So a set the list does not hold (one "+ New" created) is not asked for its layers while its draft is in hand. A listed set, a set with no draft, an unreadable list and every environment-scope read are read as before.

No REST answer, export, prop, accepted input or type member changes.

## Measured before editing (H1 to H3, per site)

The client's `layered()` resolves a 404 as an all-null envelope and does not reject, so no `.catch(() => null)` at these sites ever absorbed it. The browser still logs each request. The framework (objectstack `bafb58bb`, `getMetaItemLayered`) reads the overlay at state `active` and the code layer from the artifact registry; a draft row is neither, and `createMetaLayeredAnswer` refuses as `absent` when no layer is present. So a draft-only item answers 404, before and after any number of draft saves.

| Site | H1: fires for a draft-only item? | H2: answer in hand | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| OWD overview, load | yes, per draft-only object on every open | the package's published object list, same run | changed |
| OWD overview, save | yes, per changed draft-only row | the row's saved state from the load, plus the fresh draft | changed |
| List-view panel, load | yes, for a view the panel created; also for a view that exists nowhere | the draft only (the object's `listViews` from the metadata cache is not that answer) | changed for a drafted view; the never-created view still asks |
| Edit page, load | yes, on open | none: no published read precedes it, and its answer feeds the lock banner, overlay diff and reset verdict even with a draft | kept |
| Edit page, post-save refresh (H3) | yes: after every create, and after a save of an item whose load found no layer | `createMode`, or the load's no-layer answer | changed |
| Edit page, reset refresh | no: it runs only on the reset arm (`isResetSemantic`), which needs a packaged baseline | not needed | unchanged |
| Edit page, publish refresh | no: it runs after a successful publish, which makes a layer | not needed | unchanged |
| Edit page, discard refresh | yes: discarding a never-published item's draft leaves no layer | the load's no-layer answer | changed (see Deviations) |
| Embedded item editor, save | H1 falsified: it fires on save, not on open | none: it holds the item snapshot and the parent's name; the parent's answer lives in the page and reaching it needs a prop | kept |
| Permission matrix, load (package door) | yes, for a "+ New" set on every open | the published set list the editor already reads | changed |
| Permission matrix, package-door save re-read (H3) | yes, on every save of a "+ New" set | none safe: this read decides which other packages' rows a save keeps (objectui#9420), and the open-time list can be stale | kept |
| Permission matrix, environment-door post-save re-read (H3) | no: a live save makes a layer | not needed | unchanged |

## Pins

One request-counting suite per editor, each the REAL editor over a REAL `MetadataClient` whose transport is an in-memory server answering as the framework does (404 for `/layers` with no layer and for `?state=draft` with no draft):
- `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx`: load and save of a draft-only object send no `/layers`, and its row reads its draft as before. Controls: a published object sends one per load and one per save; a draft-only object whose draft read fails reads its baseline as before.
- `ObjectListViewInspector.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx`: a drafted, never-published view sends no `/layers`, and the buffer holds the draft as before. Control: a published view with no draft sends one.
- `ResourceEditPage.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx`: no re-read after a save or a discard of an item whose load found no layer, and none after a create, with the editor showing what it showed before. Controls: a published item's save and discard each re-read exactly once.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx`: a "+ New" set sends no `/layers` on open and the matrix shows its draft. Controls: a published set, with a draft and without one, sends one; the set list is requested once.
- Updated: `PermissionMatrixEditor.readDecorationStrip.test.tsx` (its double's set list now names the published set, as the server's does) and `PermissionMatrixEditor.packageDoorRereadRefusal.test.tsx` (its draft-only case now counts one layered read, the save's).

**Reverse check, per file** (one-time, not committed; run on `db850ce`). Each source file was replaced by its base blob (`230e4b2`), with the on-disk hash checked equal to that blob. That file's pins were run, then the file was restored from `HEAD`, with its hash checked equal to `HEAD`'s blob and `git diff HEAD` empty. A trap restored it on exit. Predicted directions held:
- OWD overview: 2 failed, 1 passed. Load "expected 1 to be +0", save "expected 2 to be +0"; the failed-draft control stayed green.
- List-view panel: 1 failed, 1 passed ("expected 1 to be +0"); the published control stayed green.
- Edit page: 3 failed, 2 passed. Save "expected 2 to be 1", create "expected 1 to be +0", discard "expected 2 to be 1"; both published controls stayed green.
- Permission matrix: 2 failed, 10 passed across three files. The new pin's "+ New" case failed with "expected 1 to be +0", and the updated draft-only re-read case with "expected 2 to be 1"; the decoration-strip suite stayed green.

## Gates (local `HEAD` `46ae4e3`, after merging `origin/main` `340bfab`)

- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2`: exit 0, "Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total".
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` shows all six touched test files in the test program.
- `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over 205 files: exit 0, "Test Files 205 passed (205) / Tests 1506 passed (1506)", lock verdict `command-exit 0`. The files are all of `studio-design/`, every app-shell test naming one of the four editors, `MetadataDetailDrawer` or `ResourceRouter`, the objectui#11892 pins, and `viewCacheInvalidation.guard.test.tsx`. There is no `*.guard.test.*` in `studio-design/` or `metadata-admin/` (zero of 779 tracked files there).
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`: exit 0.
- Derived from the diff: `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` (new `vi.mock` sites), `check:test-path-roots` (new tests), `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0.
- Not run locally, declared to CI: the remaining app-shell suites and `pnpm lint`.

## Deviations

- **List-view panel: a published view with a pending draft no longer reads `/layers` either.** Its answer was never used there (the buffer is the draft), and this is the shape PR objectui#11892 gave the leaf and flow loads. The order also says an item with a layer is read exactly as today. Read request-for-request, this site is narrower than that sentence. Nothing the panel holds tells a published view from a never-published one, so the alternative is to keep this read and report the site.
- **Edit page: the discard refresh was fixed in place.** It is not in the claim's line list, but it is in the claimed file. It has the same defect class and the same gate as the post-save refresh, and no other claim holds the file.
- **Timing:** the list-view panel's load and the permission matrix's package-door load now wait for the draft read, or for the in-flight set list, before reading layers: one round trip more, as for PR objectui#11892's leaf and flow loads.
- No live-server reading: no runnable framework backend is in this container. The framework's behaviour was read from objectstack source, and the pins use an in-memory server shaped like it, as PR objectui#11892 did.

## Acceptance notes

- **Left on the card**, each measured above: the edit page's first load of a never-published item; the embedded item editor's save; the permission matrix's package-door save re-read; the list-view panel's read of a view that exists nowhere yet.
- **Noted, not filed** (read-only inference, no reach measured): `EmbeddedItemEditor` saves its parent in publish mode over the parent's published `effective`. It never reads the parent's pending draft, and for a never-published parent it reads `{}`.
